traits.name: Vigilant Scout
traits.description: Accustomed to watching the ridgelines for bandits and beasts.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on all Perception & Tracking checks.

traits.name: Pious Devotee
traits.description: Never passes an altar without pouring a libation or offering prayer.
traits.perks: Starts with +2 Divine Standing with Hermes & Apollo; libations restore double stamina.

traits.name: Silver-Tongued Orator
traits.description: Gifted in the heroic art of persuasive speech in civic assemblies.

traits.name: Dauntless Courage
traits.description: Your bronze heart does not falter when encountering supernatural terrors.
